$terminals.fallback: Ctrl+Q submits on any terminal, mapped or not: Ctrl+letter rides the ASCII control range, the same always-available vocabulary that carries Enter. Ctrl+J is the one letter that cannot serve, because 0x0a collides with LF and Claude Code names that key "enter", which no pattern can bind.
$terminals.mappings: Ctrl+Enter reaches Claude Code only where the terminal has been told to send CSI 13;5u for it. Recipes for iTerm2, Windows Terminal and VS Code are in the dotfiles README under Terminal key mappings.
